delete.description:
Only while it is still a proposal.

A published picture is part of the listing, and a vendor pulling one is an
edit to the listing - which goes through review like every other edit.

PriceSummaryOut.description: The one price a comparison row can honestly show, plus its provenance.
PriceSummaryOut.title: PriceSummaryOut

ToolPageOut.description: One page of hub rows. `count` is the size of the whole filtered set.
ToolPageOut.title: ToolPageOut

ToolFacetOut.description:
One recorded fact about a tool, carrying its own label.

The list rows ship bare slugs, which is all a filter needs. A profile names
what it shows, and resolving a slug to a label client-side would mean a
second copy of the taxonomy in the frontend - or a request for the whole of
it, which `list_facets` counts over every listable tool to answer.
ToolFacetOut.title: ToolFacetOut

ToolScreenshotOut.description:
One picture of the tool, in every width it was rendered at.

`url` is for a bare `src` and `srcset` is the real payload: the same capture
at several widths, so the browser picks by viewport rather than being sent
the desktop rendition on a phone. `width` and `height` are the source's, and
are what lets a figure reserve its space before the image arrives.
ToolScreenshotOut.title: ToolScreenshotOut

ErrorSchema.description:
The body every documented 4xx carries.

Ninja documents only the success shape by default, so an error shape that the
frontend branches on has to be declared explicitly on the route.
ErrorSchema.title: ErrorSchema

CatalogStatsOut.description: What the homepage lede states: a count, a date and a price range.
CatalogStatsOut.title: CatalogStatsOut

ToolSubmissionIn.description: What a submitter may state. None of it is published verbatim.
ToolSubmissionIn.title: ToolSubmissionIn

MyListingOut.description:
An owner's own view of a listing.

Carries every field in `OWNER_EDITABLE_FIELDS` because the owner's editor
prefills from here rather than from the public profile, which 404s on a
listing that is not listable - the one its owner most needs to correct.
MyListingOut.title: MyListingOut

PriceProposalIn.description: A proposed figure. `plan` is the plan code, or null for a missing plan.
PriceProposalIn.title: PriceProposalIn

MyScreenshotOut.description:
An owner's own view of a picture they uploaded, at any status.

Carries `status` and `review_note` because the pending and rejected states
are the two an owner needs explained: a picture that is on the profile needs
no telling, and one that was turned down should say why rather than appear
to have vanished.
MyScreenshotOut.title: MyScreenshotOut

ScreenshotUploadIn.description: The fields that travel beside the file in a multipart upload.
ScreenshotUploadIn.title: ScreenshotUploadIn
